name: FalkorDB
description: FalkorDB is a low-latency property graph database built on sparse matrices (GraphBLAS), aimed at knowledge graphs and GraphRAG. It runs as a Redis module queried with OpenCypher from any Redis client, and FalkorDB Browser adds a web UI for queries and exploring graphs.

notes.text: Log in to FalkorDB Browser with host localhost, port 6379, an empty username and the requirepass password from /etc/redis/falkordb.conf.
If you open the browser under another address (new IP, hostname, reverse proxy), set NEXTAUTH_URL in /opt/falkordb-browser_data/.env and run systemctl restart falkordb-browser.
